# Sound Life inputs

If you have access to the restricted Sound Life data, place these files here:

- `acquisition_metadata.tsv`
- `role_wave_mask.tsv`
- `eval_wave_utility.tsv`

The required checksums are in `analysis/sound_life_matching/spec.json`. The
adapter checks them before running the matching analysis. These files are
available separately to authorized users and are not redistributed here.
